label: late original steps / <DEL> when first token is x,z,c,0,1,o,e,n and input is b,p,s,i,3,j or <DEL>
explanation: Fires only at the end of the input: original steps with t >= 5 (mostly the last 1-3 original tokens, rate climbing with orig_idx, so long sequences L=8-9 dominate) and the <DEL> step (31% of mass). It never fires in the copy phase or at t <= 3. Within that window it is modulated by (a) the current input, with b, p, s, then i, 3, j, <DEL> strongly favored, and (b) the sequence content, especially the first original token being one of x, z, c, 0, 1, o, e, n (and more such tokens or more digits generally raise the rate). It fires mostly on the first occurrence of the input token. The largest activations are on b/p/s near the end of a long sequence, followed by the <DEL> step at about 0.5-0.8 of max. The conjunctive predicate reaches only F1 ~0.4 on dev (precision ~0.31, recall ~0.55), so the unit looks like a graded, distributed accumulation of evidence about sequence content rather than a crisp boolean feature.
